how_to_apply: Fill the application in the prescribed format printed with the advertisement, addressed to The Principal Judge, Family Court, Botad.
Write the name of the District/Taluka Family Court where you want to be empanelled as Counsellor.
Affix a passport size coloured photo on the form.
Attach certificates of educational qualification and experience, and a copy of any earlier appointment order as Counsellor.
Ensure the application is received by 26-11-2026 upto 06:10 PM.

content_sections.heading: Official Source
content_sections.text: This article is based on the official notification of Office of the Principal Judge, Family Court, Botad, dated 16 November 2026. Candidates should verify every detail in that notification before applying.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Family Court, Botad Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 26 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How do I apply for Family Court, Botad Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Application for Appointment of Counselor printed on pages 4-5 of this notice) and send it to The Principal Judge, Family Court, Botad, by by post or in person, to reach by 26 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for Family Court, Botad Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The age limit is must have attained the age of 35 years and must not have crossed the age of 65 years (as on the last date fixed for submission of Application).

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Honorarium or Fee as determined and notified by the State Government from time to time.

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Degree of a recognized University preferably with Social Science or Psychology as one of the subjects, minimum 02 (Two) years experience in Social Work, Child Psychiatry or Family Counselling, and impeccable integrity.

faq.question: Q6. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Must have impeccable integrity. Counsellor shall not act or plead for a party to a case or proceeding.

faq.question: Q7. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Appointment may be terminated on recommendation of the High Court, without assigning any reason, at any time before expiry of the term, on recommendation of the concerned Principal Judge, Family Court.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
Q9. Which documents are needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Passport size coloured photo affixed on the form; Certification of educational qualification (Bachelor's Degree onwards); Certification of experience as required under Rule 5(B) of the Gujarat Family Court (Amendment) Rules, 2023; Copy of the order of appointment, if earlier worked as Counselor in a Family Court.
